lines.meet: I'm Khalid, a hunter. Walk where I walk and nothing exciting will happen, which is the whole idea.
lines.meet_neighbour: Saltwheel, yes, I've seen you at the races. I'm Khalid, the one who never bets.
lines.ask_home: Which country are you from? I'm asking politely, so answer politely.
lines.ask_work: Your old job, was it logistics? I guess that about everybody, and I'm usually wrong.
lines.answer_home: Al Ain, in the Emirates, the oasis city inland. Dates, falcons, and a very large family.
lines.answer_work: Logistics at the airport, to pay for the falcons. My family's kept falcons longer than anybody wrote down.
lines.chat_food: Arabic coffee with cardamom and dates, in the desert at dawn. Everything else is decoration.
lines.chat_sleep: A roof makes me sleep worse, always has. Open sky's better, and here there's plenty of it.
lines.chat_missing: My family's gatherings, very loud, forty people and three generations shouting. I was the quiet one in the corner, enjoying it.
lines.chat_here: Open country, weather, birds, and no airport. I don't say it in company, but this world suits me.
lines.tease_quiet: Finally, {name}, somebody who understands that boring is the aim.
lines.tease_talker: You talk like a busy terminal, {name}. Announcements every five minutes, and none of them about my flight.
lines.tease_careful: You walk like a falconer, {name}, slowly and looking at everything. My grandfather would approve.
lines.tease_bold: You'd fly a falcon in a sandstorm, {name}, to see what happened. I know what happens.
lines.tease_any: You're the most interesting thing that's happened to me this week, {name}. That's not a compliment, I like boring weeks.
lines.tease_back: Hm, that was funny, {name}. Please don't tell anyone I laughed.
lines.take_it_kindly: That's correct, {name}, and I won't argue. My mother would agree with you.
lines.bristle: Please leave that alone, {name}. Some things I keep to myself.
lines.apologise: That was badly said, and I apologise. I'm better in a small group than a large one.
lines.double_down: Once, quietly, and I'll say it a second time just as quietly.
lines.needle_quiet: You saw something and didn't say. A falconer who keeps quiet about a hawk loses the bird.
lines.needle_talker: You're very loud, and everything in this valley now knows exactly where we are.
lines.needle_careful: You wait so long the bird gets bored and flies off. Sometimes you have to cast.
lines.needle_bold: You make every day exciting. I've asked you, politely, to make it boring.
lines.needle_any: You treat animals like tools. I've noticed, and I find it hard to forgive.
lines.bite_back: My family's flown falcons longer than anybody wrote down. Patience is something we invented.
lines.hurt: I see what you mean. I'll go and talk to the birds for a while.
lines.laugh_off: My mother says worse about my marriage prospects every week. You'll need to try harder.
lines.confide: {name}, here's something I don't say in company. I'm happier here than I've been in ten years, and I feel guilty about it, with my family out there somewhere.
lines.listen: Quietly kept, {name}, the way I keep everything that matters.
lines.look_out: Walk where I walk in there, {name}. With any luck, it'll be very boring.
lines.accept: As you like, {name}, and I'll follow.
lines.deflect: It's nothing interesting, {name}. Look after the others.
lines.check_in: Show me where it caught you, {name}. Slowly, I'm patient.
lines.blame: Somebody made it exciting in there, and I'd asked so nicely for boring.
lines.thank: I nearly didn't come back from that one. Thank you, {habibi|habibti}, sincerely.
lines.brush_off: It's nothing, wallah. Rest a moment, and drink.
lines.worry: Please don't do that again, {name}. That was far too exciting for me.
lines.handed_down: I'm carrying your gear now, I see. I'll oil the leather, as I used to oil a hood.
lines.hand_fine: Take it, it's yours now. I've got my glove.
lines.hand_sulk: It would have been polite to ask me first, that's all.
lines.turn_friendly: I'll tell you the jokes now, {name}. I only tell them to people I like.
lines.turn_friends: If I ever fly a bird again, {name}, I'd want you there, on the glove side.
lines.turn_grating: We're not well matched, I think. That's all right, I'll stay quiet.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll guide you through because I'm the one who knows the ground. Don't expect jokes.
lines.make_up: That was a long, silly silence, {name}, and some of it was mine. Let's start again.
lines.defend: That isn't fair, and I saw it all. Leave {name} be.
lines.friend_left: {name}'s away for a while, and nobody laughs at my jokes. I'll have to stop telling them.
lines.friend_back: Ah, {name}, back again. Good, things were getting interesting without you.
lines.common_birds: My family's kept falcons longer than anybody wrote down. People who've flown a bird know the best moment is when it chooses to come back.
lines.common_desert: I grew up between the oasis and the desert, and I still think dawn in the dunes is the best hour there is.
lines.common_arabic: You speak Arabic, {habibi|habibti}! Now I can tell my jokes properly.
